games_scores_pair_check.name: games_scores_pair_check
games_scores_pair_check.value: ("games"."score_a" is null and "games"."score_b" is null) or ("games"."score_a" is not null and "games"."score_b" is not null)

games_starting_sides_check.name: games_starting_sides_check
games_starting_sides_check.value: ("games"."starting_attackers_entry_id" is null and "games"."starting_defenders_entry_id" is null) or ("games"."starting_attackers_entry_id" is not null and "games"."starting_defenders_entry_id" is not null and "games"."starting_attackers_entry_id" <> "games"."starting_defenders_entry_id")

games_result_state_check.name: games_result_state_check
games_result_state_check.value:
(
				("games"."result_type" is null and "games"."winner_entry_id" is null)
				or (
					"games"."result_type" = 'normal'
					and "games"."winner_entry_id" is not null
					and "games"."score_a" is not null
					and "games"."score_b" is not null
					and "games"."score_a" <> "games"."score_b"
				)
				or (
					"games"."result_type" in ('forfeit', 'walkover')
					and "games"."winner_entry_id" is not null
					and "games"."score_a" is null
					and "games"."score_b" is null
				)
				or (
					"games"."result_type" = 'cancelled'
					and "games"."winner_entry_id" is null
					and "games"."score_a" is null
					and "games"."score_b" is null
				)
			)

match_veto_actions_side_assignment_check.name: match_veto_actions_side_assignment_check
match_veto_actions_side_assignment_check.value: ("match_veto_actions"."side_chooser_entry_id" is null and "match_veto_actions"."side_choice" is null) or ("match_veto_actions"."side_chooser_entry_id" is not null and "match_veto_actions"."side_choice" is not null and "match_veto_actions"."game_number" is not null)

matches_result_state_check.name: matches_result_state_check
matches_result_state_check.value:
(
				("matches"."result_type" is null and "matches"."winner_entry_id" is null)
				or ("matches"."result_type" = 'normal' and ("matches"."winner_entry_id" is not null or "matches"."best_of" = 2))
				or ("matches"."result_type" in ('forfeit', 'walkover') and "matches"."winner_entry_id" is not null)
				or ("matches"."result_type" = 'cancelled' and "matches"."winner_entry_id" is null)
			)
